correctness.rationale: On the coordinate torus multiply by the invertible monomial and invert x to obtain Q(y)=sum_i c_i y_i y_(i+1). Its Hessian is a weighted symmetric cycle. For odd n the determinant is 2 product c_i; for n=2m the parity-ordered cyclic bidiagonal block B has det B=product_odd c + (-1)^(m-1) product_even c. Positive weights imply det B=0 exactly when 4|n and the alternating products balance. A nonzero (m-1)-minor makes corank H exactly 2. The two parity-supported nullvectors have no zero supported entries, so projectivized kernel intersects the torus as P1 minus its two endpoints, reduced; local linear diagonalization of the quadratic form yields transverse rank n-2 throughout. Independently verified exact Hessian ranks for lengths 5,6,8,10,12 and weighted balanced/unbalanced eight-cycles. This concerns the torus only, not boundary strata.
